payload.name: E64D and apilimod inhibition of SARS-CoV-2
payload.fact: E64D and apilimod potently decrease the amount of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in cell culture supernatants with minimal cytotoxicity.

provenance.title: A Simplified Quantitative Real-Time PCR Assay for Monitoring SARS-CoV-2 Growth in Cell Culture
provenance.quote_or_locus: We found that E64D (inhibitor of endosomal proteases cathepsin B and L) and apilimod (endosomal trafficking inhibitor) potently decreased the amount of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in cell culture supernatants with minimal cytotoxicity
